host_galaxy.comment:
Savaglio+2009: GRB type in Table 1: short. Table 2 is pseudophotometry in AB magnitudes, corrected for Galactic extinction; it is not a complete list of all original observed photometry. No host coordinates, redshift uncertainty, or redshift method are reported in Tables 1-2.
Fong+2022: Fong+2022 Table 2 Gold host association; Silver, Bronze, and Inconclusive associations were not imported. Host J2000 coordinates are from Table 2; Table A1 supplies the photometry. All magnitudes are AB and explicitly uncorrected for Galactic extinction in the burst direction. The table does not unambiguously identify the redshift method; redshift_type is null unless explicitly marked D. Host upper limits have no single uniformly stated confidence level; no 3-sigma label was invented.
Savaglio+2009: Source access: arXiv v3 Table 1–2 TeX was used after the IOP VoR/MRT route was blocked; this is a documented substitution.
Merged-field decision: host coordinates taken from Fong+2022 according to the direct-measurement priority rule.
Merged-field decision: redshift, error, and type taken as one tuple from Fong+2022 according to the recency/method priority rule.
